collection_policy: Every observation carrying status=pass below is bound to receipts in collection_receipts that actually contain its evidence: each receipt records its own argv, source SHA, UTC timestamp, ORIGINAL exit code and the output it collected. The three status=unknown controls carry no receipt asserting a measurement, because none was taken. Non-zero exits are reported as-is and classified; none is silenced. evidence_items.error_semantics: resolve_auth_mode returns a (mode, error) tuple and never raises. An invalid ODP_AUTH_OIDC_ENABLED returns ('local', reason) at mode.py:95-96; an invalid ODP_AUTH_MODE returns ('local', reason) at mode.py:97-98; a mode/flag conflict returns (mode, reason) at mode.py:101-104. oidc_provider_enabled is the fail-closed consumer: it is True only when mode == 'oidc' AND error is None (mode.py:126-127), so a self-contradicting environment disables OIDC rather than guessing. evidence_items.description: Login route omits the OIDC button and refuses provider=oidc when authMode is local
evidence_items.observation: Line 342 computes const showOidc = authMode === "oidc" and passes it to renderLoginFormHtml at :344-347 (R60). The renderer builds oidcButtonHtml only when options.showOidc is true (:68, R48), so in local mode the "使用 OIDC 登入" anchor is not present in the HTML at all. A direct GET /login?provider=oidc in local mode is refused at :302-312: the guard if (provider === "oidc") at :302 immediately tests if (authMode !== "oidc") at :303 and returns code WEB_AUTH_PROVIDER_DISABLED with a fixed { status: 503, headers: { "cache-control": "no-store" } } at :311, before the provider branch at :315 is entered -- so there is no 404 path and no provider call (R49). An unresolvable mode is refused earlier at :268-281, also 503.

evidence_items.description: Session, CSRF and throttle controls do not depend on OIDC state
evidence_items.lines: session.ts:396-407 (cookie options), runtime.ts:157 (verifyCsrfOrigin), login/route.ts:471-520 (throttle before credential check)
evidence_items.observation: The web session cookie is __Host-oday_web_session (runtime.ts:3) and both session cookie option sets are issued with httpOnly, secure, sameSite "lax" and path "/" (session.ts:396-399 and :404-407) -- R41. CSRF is an origin/referer check, verifyCsrfOrigin, defined at runtime.ts:157 and invoked by apps/web/src/app/login/route.ts:361, apps/web/src/app/auth/password/route.ts:91 and apps/web/src/app/auth/logout/route.ts:27 -- R42. The login throttle runs before credential verification: the store is obtained at login/route.ts:471, beginAttempt is awaited at :489, and authenticateLocalCredentials is only reached at :520; an unreachable store fails closed with HTTP 503 (:482 and :499) rather than serving an unthrottled login -- R43. Throttle state persists in identity.login_attempts (loginThrottle.ts:445, :503, :511, :519) -- R44. Auth-mode independence, stated precisely: loginThrottle.ts contains no auth-mode or OIDC environment identifier at all, and session.ts contains exactly one -- session.ts:249 passes environment.ODP_WEB_OIDC_ISSUER to store.resolveOidcAccount (R45). That read sits inside the legacy sealed-OIDC-cookie migration branch if (!value.sid) at session.ts:219 and is an account-lookup key, not a mode resolution (R57); the password path seals sessions through sealWebSessionReference (login/route.ts:623, auth/password/route.ts:264), the sid-bearing reference format, so a password-first session never enters that branch (R58). In runtime.ts every auth-mode identifier occurs between lines 83 and 141 (R46), outside verifyCsrfOrigin at :157, so the CSRF check does not consult the auth mode either.

Collecting the source showed one such read does exist -- session.ts:249 on the legacy OIDC-session migration path -- so the claim is narrowed and bound to receipts that read the source.
